name: warpdecode_tensorcore_gather_grouped_gemm_decode_contract
verification: EMPIRICAL: index-contract obligations checked against live moe_sort metadata at decode configs ntok in {16,32,64} (LE=16, top_k=8, tile_tokens_dim=128) -> ALL_PASS. The first draft's bounds (mn_limit<=128, p2e<expanded) were WRONG and the CZS check caught them; corrected below to the true moe_sort semantics.
description: Index/layout + obligation contract for the production tensor-core WarpDecode FC1 path (Sm100 persistent blockscaled gather-grouped GEMM + SwiGLU, NVFP4). Covers the decode config-sweep iteration; per-config correctness (ref-check) and measured config-optimality are obligations.

index_contract.tile_scheduler: persistent SCHEDULER warp dispatches tile_idx in [0, num_non_exiting_tiles); only valid tiles reach consumer warps via tile_info_pipeline (n_tiles = num_non_exiting_tiles + exit sentinel; e.g. 17 tiles, 16 valid at LE=16)
index_contract.tile_to_group: tile_idx_to_group_idx[tile] = local expert e in [0, LE)
index_contract.mn_limit: tile_idx_to_mn_limit[tile] is a CUMULATIVE valid-row offset into the padded expanded space: t2lim[i] = i*tile_tokens_dim + valid_rows_in_expert_i, monotonically increasing, <= total_num_padded_tokens (2048). (NOT a per-tile count bounded by 128 -- corrected after CZS check.)
index_contract.gather: permuted_idx_to_expanded_idx[p] in [0, ntok*top_k) maps a permuted (expert-major) row to its source expanded row; expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx[x] in [0, total_num_padded_tokens) is the inverse into the padded space
index_contract.n_tiling: N=4096 tiled by mma_tiler_n -> ~32 N-tiles/expert; total ~512 tiles at G8 decode >> 148 SMs => SATURATED
index_contract.k_loop: K=7168 streamed in mma_tiler_k chunks via TMA(B,SFB) with cluster multicast; UMMA accumulates in TMEM; AB pipeline depth = _compute_stages(SMEM_capacity), SMEM-maxed
index_contract.scale: e4m3 scale per 16-element K-block -> 448 K-blocks; SFB sourced from TMEM; cluster_n<=4 for SF multicast
index_contract.epilogue: SwiGLU silu(gate)*up fused in epilogue over the Acc (UMMA->epilogue) pipeline; C N-major (swap_ab=False) requires N%8==0 (decode N=4096 ok)

obligations.label: group index in range
obligations.claim: tile_idx_to_group_idx[tile] in [0, LE) for all valid tiles

obligations.label: numerical correctness per config
obligations.claim: tensor-core output matches the dequant FP32 reference (ref-check) for each swept config
obligations.status: VERIFIED PASS for {(128,128)/(1,1),(128,256)/(1,1),(256,256)/(2,1),(256,128)/(2,1),(256,64)/(2,1)} at decode weight shape (m=128,n=65536,k=7168,16 experts); fp16-C overflow on large-K random data is a test-data artifact (production path cosine-verified in e2e)

obligations.label: config optimality (decode)
obligations.claim: autotuner choice mma_tiler=(128,128), cluster=(1,1), no-prefetch is latency-optimal

obligations.label: memory-bound ceiling
obligations.claim: decode kernel is memory-bound on the expert-weight load at ~70% of 6.8 TB/s peak; obvious config levers exhausted
obligations.status: ESTABLISHED: 235MB FC1 weight / 49.0us = 4.79 TB/s = 70% peak; AB pipeline SMEM-maxed + TMA multicast + persistent already engaged; remaining 30% = SF/TMEM + SwiGLU epilogue + scheduler, reachable only via deep kernel surgery
